senses.gloss: (b. h., cmp. זבל) [to give a feast,] to slaughter, sacrifice.
units: Ḥull. II, 3 (ref. to Deut. XXVII, 7) מה שאתה זוֹבֵחַ וכ׳ thou mayest eat what thou (a human hand) cuttest.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 60b:8">Snh. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>בזובח לעכו״ם</he> of one sacrificing to an idol; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="G00264"><he>זָבוּחַ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> (play on <cite ref="M00708"><he>מזבח</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 32:5">Ex. XXXII, 5</cite>) <he>מֵהַזָּ׳ לפניו וכ׳</he> he was afraid on account of him who lay killed before him (Hur); a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 62a:5">Snh. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ וקיטר וכ׳</he> if he slaughtered a sacrifice, and burnt &c. (to an idol).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:6">Ib. VII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 60b:1">60ᵇ</cite>) <he>המְזַבֵּחַ</he> Talm. ed. (Mish. <he>הזובח</he>) he who offers an animal (to an idol), a. fr.—V. <cite ref="G00044"><he>זָבַל</he></cite>

senses.gloss: to be sacrificed, to be slaughtered; to die as a martyr.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 1:1">Zeb. I, 1</cite> <he>שנִזְבְּחוּ שלא לשמן</he> which were offered not for the purpose for which they were dedicated. Y. Snh. X, 29ᶜ top (play on <he>עלי זבח</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 50:5">Ps. L, 5</cite>) <he>שעילו אותי ונזבחו על שמי</he> who raised me and sacrificed themselves for my name’s sake; a. fr.
